about: The Carnet search bench (plan « Le sommaire », brick S0): realistic queries in fr/en/de/es/nl against the DEMO Carnet only (App/Resources/Demo/notebook-demo.json, notebook-demo-trip.json, family-notebook-demo.json; Dutch: `fixtures.nl`, the English demo in Dutch, folders and section titles left in the bridge's English as today), each with the results that answer it (`expect`: any of them counts; « *dated » = every item with an `offset` in the case's `window`, « *dated:task » its tasks, « *dated:fam » the family's) and the category the person means. One file for the bridge and both apps. Replayed by bridge-rs src/notebook/search_bench.rs (cargo test search_bench -- --ignored --nocapture; BIPAGENTS_BENCH_OUT=<file> writes the report).
ids: page:<key> (keys in `pages`; page:tasks the tasks page, page:records_<type> a records page), fact:<page>/<section id>/<n>, task:<demo id>, record:<demo id>, doc:<key> (`documents`, the demo's order; agent-made or received), drive:<key> (`fixtures.drives`), fam:list:<list>/<item>, fam:page:<id>. `offset`: the item's date in days from the run day, as the demo dates it.
